content.comment_body: Hello, Does anyone know if [company_name] is addressing the DPI scaling issues in [product_name] [version_no] for high-resolution screens? I'm using a 3200x1800 display, and currently, [product_name] doesn't scale much except for a few text elements. It's frustrating since I can't view the interface clearly on a 13.3" laptop. Screenshot attached.
The answer you expect may not be found in this forum. To get a clear response, submit a support request. That way you'll receive a specific answer.

I've tested various monitors for work and running different applications. In my experience, using high-resolution screens often leads to more problems—they aren't visually optimal and tend to strain the eyes. Many systems struggle to handle high resolutions smoothly. Personally, I stick with 16:10 monitors at 1680x1050 resolution. For instance, [product_name] works really well at this setting on both Windows and Linux. Sometimes, a higher resolution isn't always better—you should choose what fits you best.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have reported major usability problems with [product_name] [version_no] on high-resolution screens, particularly related to DPI scaling. Most UI elements remain too small to use effectively, rendering the application nearly unusable on devices such as 13.3'' laptops with 3200x1800 resolution. The scaling only partly affects some text, leaving most of the interface difficult to access or navigate.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to offer proper DPI scaling and seamless usability on current high-resolution displays.
